race.comment: STOLEN KISS (8) got back in the Halidon Cup on a day when nothing was running on, and that run is best forgotten. She was in career best form prior, and back in this company, she can bounce back to win a race like this. CHEF MILITAIRE (2) is an 8YO gelding who is also racing at a career high, going back to back in his last couple of starts, including an easy all the way win here 3 weeks ago. He cops a tough gate, but if he can find the top without much trouble, then he will take plenty of catching again. I'M A DEXSTAR (7) was not far away fresh up in a tougher race, and then was a game third here last time out. He will be spot on for this, and has a good chance to break his win drought. RAIKOKE (1) made his track debut here 3 weeks ago, and ran his best race in a while, finishing a solid second as the favourite. He has the pole position against a similar lineup, and another honest effort is expected. I NEED A DRINK (6) strips fitter second up, and he has won 10 races here. Each way.
